questions.questionText: In which does thermal conduction not occur?

options.text: a gas
a liquid
a solid
a vacuum

questions.questionText:
The metal surface of a kettle is hot.
What happens to the cool air outside the kettle when it comes into contact with the hot kettle?

options.text: The density of the air decreases and the air falls.
The density of the air decreases and the air rises.
The density of the air increases and the air falls.
The density of the air increases and the air rises.

questions.questionText:
Some hot water is sealed inside a metal can. The can is in a vacuum in outer space. The hot
water slowly cools down.
How does the thermal energy escape into space?

options.text: by conduction then convection
by conduction then radiation
by evaporation then convection
by evaporation then radiation

questions.questionText:
An object is placed 30cm in front of a plane mirror.
Which statement describes the image of the object?

options.text: The image is the same size and 30cm from the object.
The image is the same size and 60cm from the object.
The image is smaller and 30cm from the object.
The image is smaller and 60cm from the object.

questions.questionText:
A small object O is placed near a converging lens, as shown. The lens forms an image I.
I O
Which statement is correct?

options.text: The image I is diminished.
The image I is inverted.
The image I is real.
The object O is closer to the lens than its principal focus.

questions.questionText:
An eclipse of the Sun happens when the Moon comes between the Earth and the Sun.
Which statement is correct?

options.text: Infra-red radiation from the Sun disappears before visible light and ultra-violet radiation.
Ultra-violet radiation from the Sun disappears before visible light and infra-red radiation.
Visible light from the Sun disappears before ultra-violet radiation and infra-red radiation.
Infra-red radiation, ultra-violet radiation and visible light from the Sun all disappear at the same moment.

questions.questionText: Why is soft iron used for the core of an electromagnet?

options.text: Soft iron easily becomes a permanent magnet.
Soft iron is a good electrical conductor.
Soft iron is a poor thermal conductor.
Soft iron loses its magnetism when the current in the coil is switched off.
